_comment: Overfit probe. Identical to configs/mquake_t.json except that functional_predicates is OMITTED, so the substrate falls back to its default personal-life set (lives_in, works_at, job, ...). None of MQuAKE-T's relations are in that set, so contradiction detection should go inert and P2 should collapse toward P0. Whatever accuracy gap opens between this run and the mquake_t run is the share of P2's reported win that comes from the config flag rather than from the policy. Three policies, one model = 3 cells; this is a cheap experiment and it is the first thing a reviewer will ask for.
